title: Raw String for Secrets or Hashed Passwords
pattern: Representing sensitive security attributes (secrets, keys, raw passwords) as simple `String` types in core domain models.
why_bad: Raw `String` types have no guardrails: they can easily be accidentally printed during debugging, logged to tracking systems, included in serialization payloads, or dumped in raw core memory.
detection: Struct fields representing credentials (`password`, `secret`, `token`) typed as standard primitive strings.
counterexample: A configuration reader translating environment variables into an initial config object during startup.
fix:
Wrap the credential in a specialized secret type that hides the value on Standard display, logging, and debugging traits.
```rust
struct PasswordHash(secrecy::SecretString);
```
